label: PF Backlog 142
title: Backend: canonical run-lifecycle event taxonomy + emission (dashboard consumes)
body: Q88 (owner): the PIPELINE BACKEND (not the dashboard) must emit a canonical run-lifecycle event taxonomy (run_started, agent_stage_changed, human_input_required, run_completed, run_failed, tokens_used; project/run/agent/user dimensions). Dashboard CONSUMES it for analytics. Define schema + emit; expose via API.
_note: core/events.py canonical taxonomy (11 types: run_/stage_/agent_/human_input_required/tokens_used) -> <project>/events.jsonl. Wired run_entry.begin_run (run_started), job_manager.finish (run_completed/run_failed), stage_runner (stage_completed). Verified emit/counts/read.
